speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-one. Or on Saturday, if the font's to be believed over my mother. She says St George. She was there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At thirty-one my father was a chamberlain of the borough and had a house. I have a chamber with a cat in it and a king half-made.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enough. He banishes them in the next scene. Six years. No, ten, and then he gives four back, like a man tipping a waiter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Garter knights feast at Whitehall. I have heard of the trumpets. I am not near them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Marlowe was twenty-nine. Southwell thirty-three. I have three children, two poems in print and half a king.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody has remembered the day. I have told nobody.
